derivation: from H8324 (שָׁרַר) in the sense of twisting (compare H8270 (שֹׁר));
def: the umbilical cord, i.e. (by extension) a bodice

occurrences.text: Thy navel is like a round goblet, which wanteth not liquor: thy belly is like an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
